turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline! I finally adopted a dog last weekend, a beagle named Biscuit.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That's wonderful! I've been thinking about getting a pet too. How old is Biscuit?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: He's two years old. I got him from the shelter on Oak Street.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Nice. By the way, I just started a new job at a marketing firm called BrightPath as a junior designer.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Congrats on BrightPath! Is it downtown?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yes, near the river. I bike there every morning, about 20 minutes.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Biscuit must be getting big. How's he doing with training?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Great actually. He learned to sit and stay. We go to the park on Maple Avenue every Sunday.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Also, I switched careers, I'm now a nurse at the city hospital. Night shifts mostly.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, a nurse now! That's a big change from teaching. Proud of you.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: At BrightPath I got promoted to senior designer last week.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Two promotions feels close! Let's celebrate. Maybe that Italian place, Luigi's?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Sad news, Biscuit hurt his paw and had surgery. The vet on Oak Street fixed him up though.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Oh no, poor Biscuit! Glad the vet helped. Is he resting?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yes, lots of rest. The night shifts at the hospital make it hard to watch him, so my sister helps.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I moved apartments, by the way. I now live on Pine Street, closer to BrightPath.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Pine Street is lovely. Shorter bike ride now?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Just 10 minutes now. Half of what it used to be.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Biscuit's paw all healed? It's been a couple months.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Fully healed and back to the Maple Avenue park every Sunday. He's three now, had a birthday.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Three already! And I have news: I'm leaving BrightPath to start my own design studio.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: An entrepreneur! What will you call the studio?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: RiverInk Design. Named after the river I used to bike along to the old office.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: RiverInk, I love it. From junior designer to studio owner in under a year.

qa.question: What is the name of Melanie's dog?
What company does Caroline work for as a designer?
Where does Melanie take Biscuit every Sunday?
Which street did Caroline move to, and is it closer to her job?
Who helps Melanie watch Biscuit while he recovers, and why can't she always do it herself?
qa.answer: her sister, because of her night shifts at the hospital

qa.question: What did Caroline name her design studio and why?
qa.answer: RiverInk Design, after the river she biked along to the old office

qa.question: How did Caroline's bike commute time change after she moved?
How old was Biscuit when he had his birthday in October 2023?
Where did Biscuit have his paw surgery?
Did Caroline ever work as a nurse?
qa.answer: No; Caroline is a designer. Melanie is the nurse.
